findings.message: contains multiple layers of encoding (hex/base64/unicode escapes) (2 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Avoid multi-layer encoding; it hindles review and may indicate malicious intent.
findings.impact: Multi-layer encoding (hex/base64/unicode) significantly hinders security review.
findings.attack_vector: Chained decoding layers — attacker increases analysis cost and may hide malicious payloads.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: invokes a file-system mutation API (2 calls in this file)
findings.remediation: Require explicit user approval and restrict mutations to an allowlisted workspace path.

findings.attack_vector: writeFile/mkdir/chmod without workspace boundary check — path is not validated against workspace root.

findings.message: constructs a regular expression from a non-literal value (possible ReDoS)
findings.basis: OWASP Regular Expression Denial of Service Prevention
findings.remediation: Use bounded, allowlisted patterns and enforce input and execution limits for dynamic regular expressions.
findings.impact: An attacker-controlled regular expression can consume excessive CPU and deny service.
findings.attack_vector: A non-literal value is passed to RegExp without pattern or execution bounds.
